facts.fact: 缆绳结构：穿椅腿椅背→梁上滑轮→沿顶→末端固定在门上。
facts.anchor: the line moved across the length of the ceiling down to another pulley

facts.fact: Keller 抢管钳一击砸碎滑轮——张力释放、Claire 升出水面。
facts.anchor: connecting with the pulley fixed to the top of the pipe, obliterating it in a single strike.

facts.fact: Claire 三处绑缚：手臂、脚踝、还有喉咙——勒进白肉血肉模糊。
facts.anchor: by the arms, by the ankles, and this time by the throat as well

facts.fact: Alex 的复苏窗口：缺氧 4–6 分钟无脑损——冷水体温降可更长。
facts.anchor: four to six minutes without brain damage, longer in cold water

facts.fact: CPR 闪回：多年前与她同墓的女孩们——接触引发呕意但她必须做。
facts.anchor: The girls who were in that grave with her all those years ago.

facts.fact: Claire 复活后只有两个耳语词——
facts.anchor: But only two whispered words rose in the cold air.
